annotations.title: Draft a message to my agent

description: Drafts, without sending it, a message to their agent in China, in their own words: a new request (their sentence, the quantity, by when, a photo or a link) or, with a request number, their reply in that conversation. Nothing is sent: the message shows on a card, and they send it themselves; say “I’m drafting”, not “I’m sending”. Call it when they want to ask a person something, or reply to their agent.

demande.description: The request number, returned by my_agent_requests.

message.description: The message, as it will be sent: their words, no contact details (phone, WeChat, link) and no product reference — that goes in `produit`.

pays.description: A new request: the delivery country, as a two-letter code (FR, US, DE...); their account’s otherwise.

photo_ou_lien.description: A new request: the address of a photo or of a product page (https).

pour_quand.description: A new request: by when they want it, in their words.

produit.description: When their question is about a product Rabbit showed them: its `produit` reference. The request is attached to it.

quantite.description: A new request: the number of pieces they said.

sa_derniere_photo.description: A new request: true to attach the photo they just sent to Rabbit.

name: write_to_my_agent
title: Draft a message to my agent
